about: THE LOOKOUT (f3_hilltop) review views (sky-lift plan lane 3). Bake: lune run tools/bake/attractions.luau; lune run tools/bake/lookout/bake_alone.luau --review (or the lift's entry once tools/review/attractions_export reads build/Expansion_F4.rbxm); lune run tools/review/export.luau; then /root/.cache/spicy-rodents/venv/bin/python -I tools/review/render.py --scene build/review/scene.json --views docs/renders/skylift/lookout_views.json --out build/review/lookout --threads 2. Local points in the venue frame are noted in each desc.

views.name: lk_front_trail
views.desc: The Lookout from the hill trail's last stretch (local -20.3, ground + 5.5, -91.8), looking up at the glass front, the terrace and the lift hall.

views.name: lk_front_far
views.desc: The silhouette on the crown from the north-east slope (local -60, ground + 5.5, -150).

views.name: lk_dining_glass
views.desc: The dining room from by the counter (local 44, 5.2, 9) toward the glass front and the window bar.

views.name: lk_dining_counter
views.desc: The dining room from the window bar (local -2, 5.2, -21) toward the counter, the menu board and the fireside corner.

views.name: lk_terrace_day
views.desc: The terrace from its east end (local 44, 5.2, -27.5) toward the town: tables, parasols, the telescope, the glass rail.

views.name: lk_terrace_night
views.desc: The same at night (moonlight, the bd_night sky): the lanterns, candle jars, downlights and the lit dining room.

views.name: lk_telescope_view
views.desc: Over the telescope's shoulder (local 13.5, 7.6, -38.5) toward the town 2,000 studs away: the second vantage.

views.name: lk_hall_from_cabin
views.desc: The lift hall from an arriving cabin's door (local -27.3, 6.6, 4: cabin floor 1.5 + a standing eye) across the alight platform's place: the window into the dining room, the welcome board, the open front.

views.name: lk_hall_mouth
views.desc: Into the lift hall's open front from where the cabins leave (local -35, 6.6, -40), the sign above.

views.name: lk_steps
views.desc: The terrace steps from the trail beside them (local 30, ground + 5.5, -70).
